Every data and object a report's program makes, by name

Source: R/code_refs.R
tfl_output_data_names.Rd

The names a report's program gives what it makes: the analysis data of its ARD definition (data_id, and the analysis sets' and records' own <dataset>_sub), the ARD (ard), a figure's data steps that name what they make (out:, a fit's name:). For a screen that lists a report's data and lets a person rename one (the rename itself is the SPEC's, tfl_code_refs() finds the code that still says the old name).

Usage

tfl_output_data_names(output, study)

Arguments

output

A report (tfl_read_output()); one with several objects (contents:) gives each object's.

study

The study (tfl_read_study_spec()).

Value

A data frame, one row a name: output_id, object (the object of a report with contents:, else NA), name, kind (subset: a data the program keeps; ard; fit: a model a figure's step fits), from (what it is made from: a dataset, a data above, NA), used_by (the analyses or steps that read it, | between them).

See also

tfl_ard_data_names(), tfl_code_refs()
